function.name: cmd_controller_execute
function.description: Executes a system-level command using os.system() on Windows operating systems. It can execute single or multiple commands chained with '&&'. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

command.description: The system command to be executed. To execute multiple commands, separate them with '&&'. For example, 'dir && echo done'.

unit.description: Specifies the unit of measure for the command if applicable. This is not utilized by os.system() directly but can be used for logging or analysis purposes.

message.content: I’m sorry, but I don’t have the ability to capture images. If you’d like, I can walk you through taking a photo with your device’s camera instead!
message.reasoning: The user says "take a pic of me". We need to interpret what they want. They might want us to take a picture of them. But we can't physically take a picture. We could ask them to use their camera or provide instructions. Or we could respond that we cannot take a picture. According to policy, we should not claim to have taken a picture. We can politely say we cannot take a picture. We can offer to guide them how to take a picture. So we should respond that we cannot take a picture.
